title: Item:Crest of the Octopus

== Crest of the Octopus ==
[[File:Crest of the Octopus orb.png|right|alt=Crest of the Octopus, focus orb]]
[[File:Crest of the Octopus.png|right|alt=Crest of the Octopus, description]]
A strange sea creature graces this crest.
* {{Bind|no|drops=both}}
* The Crest of the Octopus works as a key and fits into any Octopus Socket. Usable in some quests, wilderness adventure areas and assassination challenges.

Acquired by:
* Killing certain monsters
* Looting certain treasure chests
* Pick-up just North of the Ziggurat in [[The Red Fens]]
* Breaking breakables in Dr. Rushmore's Mansion

Usable in the following assassination challenges:
*'''Dr. Rushmore's Mansion'''
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Behind the Door|Behind the Door]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets|Moving Targets]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets - EPIC|Moving Targets - EPIC]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals|Picture Portals]]
** [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals - EPIC|Picture Portals - EPIC]]
